events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Ryan threw for 286 yards and three touchdowns, Jones hauled in nine passes for 161 yards and a couple of scores, and Hester set an NFL record with his 20th return for a TD as the Falcons routed the hapless Tampa Bay Buccaneers 56-14.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons soar to easy win over hapless Bucs

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Rivers leads Chargers to 22-10 win over Bills
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers leads Chargers to 22-10 win over Bills

headlines.description: Andy Dalton caught a touchdown pass -- the first Bengals quarterback to pull off that feat -- as Cincinnati stayed undefeated on Sunday, beating Tennessee 33-7 a few hours after the Titans got sad news.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton catches TD as Bengals improve to 3-0

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked a 32-yard field as time expired, giving the Baltimore Ravens a 23-21 win over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Ravens rally past Browns on late FG

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.shortLinkText: Lions defense smothers Rodgers, rips Pack

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Terrance Williams scored the go-ahead touchdown late in the fourth quarter, and Bruce Carter returned an interception 25 yards for a TD on the next snap, capping the Dallas Cowboys' comeback from a 21-0 deficit to stun the St. Louis Rams 34-31 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys tie largest comeback, upend Rams

events.name: Oakland Raiders at New England Patriots
Minnesota Vikings at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Saints get first win of season, 20-9 over Vikings
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints get first win of season, 20-9 over Vikings

events.name: Houston Texans at New York Giants

headlines.description: Jennings rushes for 176 yards, Giants beat Texans
headlines.shortLinkText: Jennings rushes for 176 yards, Giants beat Texans

headlines.description: Rookie Jordan Matthews, the receiver who replaced DeSean Jackson in Philadelphia, caught two touchdown passes, and the Eagles beat Jackson and his Washington Redskins 37-34 on Sunday in a nasty game marred by a fourth-quarter brawl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles rally for brawl-marred win vs. Redskins

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw four touchdown passes -- three of them in a lopsided first half -- and the Indianapolis Colts dominated the Jacksonville Jaguars 44-17 on Sunday for their first win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck throws 4 TDs as Colts avoid 0-3 start

headlines.description: Drew Stanton threw a pair of third-quarter touchdown passes to rookie John Brown and Arizona rallied to beat San Francisco 23-14 on Sunday, snapping a four-game losing streak to the 49ers.

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Alex Smith leads Chiefs past Dolphins 34-15
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Smith leads Chiefs past Dolphins 34-15

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch scored on a 6-yard TD run on the first possession of overtime and the Seattle Seahawks beat the Denver Broncos 26-20 on Sunday in a Super Bowl rematch that lived up to expectations.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks halt Broncos' rally for OT victory

headlines.description: Panthers, Steelers tied at 3-3 after 1st quarter

events.name: Chicago Bears at New York Jets

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw two touchdown passes to Martellus Bennett, and the Bears took advantage of some early mistakes by the Jets before holding on for a 27-19 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler strikes early vs. Jets; Bears hold on
